dogecoin.text: Ok, here's some basic math to sufficiently make everyone depressed today 😂 ...... if you had bought $5,000 USD worth of #dogecoin about 6 months ago, you would now have very close to $1 million USD. 😳🤯 #DogecoinToTheMoon #Dogefather #doge #DogeSNL
@verge I think you need a LOT more dogecoin spaces...😂
